titles.title: Seduce Me With All Your Might

description:
Ho Yeon-Woo is a perfect man with looks, abilities, and even aura. However, he is the worst as a romantic partner, only pursuing casual encounters and mercilessly rejecting serious partners. Despite knowing this, he is called a 'fox' instead of 'Yeon-Woo' because there are many people who are attracted to him. In fact, he is... a real fox! The fox-like 'Hoin-Jok' gains life from the hearts of humans towards him. The deeper and greater the feelings, the better, but Yeon-Woo for some reason avoids deep hearts and instead rejects them when they become serious. Yeon-Woo, unable to absorb good life force, eventually falls ill and collapses. If this continues, he will die within a year. There is only one solution: find someone with a huge heart and make them fall in deep love to gain that power. Yeom-Hwa, the leader of the Hoin-Jok, injects Yeon-Woo with divine power into his eyes, allowing him to see the hearts of each person. However, the owner of the huge heart that he found after searching hard enough is a man...? And he is a judo player with broad shoulders, a college student, and a famous blunt and stubborn Go Jeong-In! Heterosexual? The other person just can't stand it? You don't need anything else. If you want to live, "Turn your life around!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
